instruction: Add a new built-in CLI command flask config that prints the loaded application's configuration as JSON, masking the values of any key containing SECRET, PASSWORD, TOKEN or KEY as "***". It must appear in flask --help, be covered by a test, and be documented alongside the other built-in commands.

index a72e6d5..adcb2db 100644
--- a/docs/cli.rst
+++ b/docs/cli.rst
@@ -11,6 +11,23 @@ option will give more information about any commands and options.
 .. _Click: https://click.palletsprojects.com/
 
 
+Configuration
+-------------
+
+The :func:`config <flask.cli.config_command>` command will print the loaded
+application's configuration as JSON. Values for keys containing "SECRET",
+"PASSWORD", "TOKEN", or "KEY" are masked as "***".
+
+.. code-block:: console
+
+    $ flask --app hello config
+    {
+      "DEBUG": false,
+      "SECRET_KEY": "***",
+      ...
+    }
+
+
 Application Discovery
 ---------------------
 
@@ -518,6 +535,20 @@ script is available. Note that you don't need to set ``--app``. ::
 .. _console script: https://packaging.python.org/tutorials/packaging-projects/#console-scripts
 
 
+Show Configuration
+------------------
+
+The :func:`config <cli.config_command>` command will print the loaded
+application's configuration as JSON. Sensitive values are masked. ::
+
+    $ flask config
+    {
+      "DEBUG": true,
+      "SECRET_KEY": "***",
+      ...
+    }
+
+
 PyCharm Integration
 -------------------

+@click.command("config", short_help="Show the config values.")
+@with_appcontext
+def config_command() -> None:
+    """Show the config values."""
+    import json
+
+    def mask(key: str, value: t.Any) -> t.Any:
+        if any(s in key.upper() for s in ("SECRET", "PASSWORD", "TOKEN", "KEY")):
+            return "***"
+        return value
+
+    config = {k: mask(k, v) for k, v in current_app.config.items()}
+    click.echo(json.dumps(config, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
+
+

+def test_config_command(runner):
+    app = Flask("test")
+    app.config["DEBUG"] = True
+    app.config["SECRET_KEY"] = "secret"
+    app.config["PASSWORD"] = "password"
+    app.config["TOKEN"] = "token"
+    app.config["KEY"] = "key"
+    app.config["OTHER"] = "other"
+
+    result = runner.invoke(app.cli, ["config"])
+    print(result.output)
+    print(result.exit_code)
+    assert result.exit_code == 0
+    import json
+    data = json.loads(result.output)
+    assert data["DEBUG"] is True
+    assert data["SECRET_KEY"] == "***"
+    assert data["PASSWORD"] == "***"
+    assert data["TOKEN"] == "***"
+    assert data["KEY"] == "***"
+    assert data["OTHER"] == "other"
+
